# Bug Fix Agent Skills

## PR Title Convention
- Frontend bugs: ix(frontend): <description> (closes #<issue>)
- Backend bugs: ix(backend): <description> (closes #<issue>)
- Full-stack: ix(fullstack): <description> (closes #<issue>)

## Branch Naming
- Always use: ix/<issue-number>-<short-kebab-description>

## PR Body Format
When creating a pull request, ALWAYS format the body with these exact sections:

### 🔍 Root Cause
<explain why the bug happened — what was wrong in the code>

### 🛠️ Fix Applied
<what was changed and why this resolves the issue>

### 📋 Files Modified
<list each file changed with a one-line description>

### ✅ Confidence Level
Rate your confidence: HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW with a brief justification.

- Always run 
pm install and
